title: Everyday Science
lines: Everyday science questions in USAT-A test general awareness, not formulas. They ask who invented or discovered something, how the human body works, which vitamin prevents which disease, what causes common diseases, basic facts about the environment and space, and common technology terms.
| Printing press with movable type | Johannes Gutenberg (about 1440)
| Laws of motion and gravitation | Isaac Newton
| Practical electric light bulb | Thomas Edison
| Largest internal organ | liver (also stores bile in the gall bladder)
| Smallest bone | stapes, in the ear
| Oxygen carrier in blood | haemoglobin in red blood cells
| Universal donor blood group | O negative
| A | night blindness | carrots, milk, liver
| C | scurvy (bleeding gums) | citrus fruit, guava
| D | rickets (soft bones) | sunlight, eggs, fish
| K | poor blood clotting | green leafy vegetables
- Iron deficiency causes anaemia; iodine deficiency causes goitre.
| Virus | polio, measles, influenza, hepatitis, dengue, rabies
| Protozoan | malaria (spread by the female Anopheles mosquito)
- Dengue is spread by the Aedes mosquito. Antibiotics act on bacteria, not viruses.
- The ozone layer, in the stratosphere, absorbs harmful ultraviolet rays. CFCs damage it.
- Greenhouse gases such as carbon dioxide and methane trap heat and cause global warming.
- Acid rain is caused mainly by sulphur dioxide and nitrogen oxides. Smog is smoke and fog mixed with pollutants.
- The Sun is a star; light from it takes about 8 minutes to reach the Earth.
- Eight planets in order: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune. Pluto was reclassified as a dwarf planet in 2006.
- Mercury is nearest the Sun; Venus is the hottest; Mars is the Red Planet; Jupiter is the largest; Saturn is famous for its rings.
| Speed of light in vacuum | about 3 × 10⁸ m/s
| Speed of sound in air | about 340 m/s
| Most abundant gas in air | nitrogen, about 78 %
| Gas plants take in for photosynthesis | carbon dioxide
- Lightning is seen before thunder is heard because light travels far faster than sound.
| CPU | Central Processing Unit, the processor
| RAM | Random Access Memory, temporary working memory
| URL | Uniform Resource Locator, a web address
> Scurvy is caused by a lack of  (A) vitamin A  (B) vitamin C  (C) vitamin D  (D) vitamin K
> B. Vitamin D is the tempting choice for bone problems, but scurvy is bleeding gums from a lack of vitamin C.
> Which disease is caused by a virus?  (A) typhoid  (B) cholera  (C) polio  (D) malaria
> C. Typhoid and cholera are bacterial; malaria is caused by a protozoan.
! The liver is the largest internal organ; the skin is the largest organ overall.
! Edison made the light bulb practical; Bell invented the telephone. Marconi is radio.
! Malaria is not a virus or a bacterium; it is a protozoan parasite carried by mosquitoes.
- A night blindness, C scurvy, D rickets, B1 beriberi.
- Penicillin Fleming 1928; telephone Bell 1876; WWW Berners-Lee.
- Eight planets; Jupiter largest, Mercury nearest, Venus hottest.
